# Amudi Purba Portfolio

> Personal portfolio and curriculum vitae of Amudi Purba, an Information Systems and Technology student at Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB) specializing in AI Systems, SDLC, STLC, Quality Assurance, and enterprise tech solutions.

## Overview
Amudi Purba is an ITB undergraduate student with practical experience in Software Testing (QA), AI/ML system development, full-stack web applications, and technology leadership.
